Video Diffusion Models (Ho, Salimans, and colleagues) treat a short clip as one diffusion sample and train a denoiser on that block of frames rather than predicting one frame at a time. [@chk-8570fd87ae39bc12200b2d71]

The network is a factorized 3D U-Net: space-only convolutions and spatial attention, plus temporal attention so the model can order frames without an absolute time index. [@chk-e097b566e01ffd0fec3adf37] Reconstruction guidance then conditions later blocks on earlier ones so autoregressive extension stays temporally coherent, unlike the replacement method. [@chk-430415dc6800d59b2cf890ad]
